why: The `make_shared` / `make_unique` factories rclcpp generates for its owning callback handle. Ours is `rclcpp::ParameterCallbackHandle = uint16_t`, a plain token: with no allocator there is nothing to own and nothing whose destruction could unregister, so `remove_on_set_parameters_callback(handle)` is explicit. A factory for an integer would be a name with nothing behind it. phase-417 W4.a.
